feature1.prompt: simplify_regexp() doesn't replace trailing groups. Description: replace_named_groups() fails to replace the final named group if the urlpattern passed in is missing a trailing '/'. For example, with input r'entries/(?P<pk>[^/.]+)/relationships/(?P<related_field>\w+)' the "related_field" does not get properly replaced. Code that reproduces this is attached. This function is used downstream in Django REST Framework. See issue ​6888.
feature1.hint_texts: This feature focuses on updating the replace_named_groups function. Developers should adjust the logic to correctly handle trailing named groups when a URL pattern is missing the trailing slash. The solution must ensure that nested parentheses are properly handled and that the end of the string is correctly detected for group replacement. Update the function’s docstring to include examples demonstrating the expected behavior when the trailing slash is absent.
feature1.entrypoint: File: django/contrib/admindocs/utils.py; Function: replace_named_groups; Review and modify the code block around lines 155-180 where the end of the named group is detected and replaced.
